title: Add texture generation via Hunyuan3D paint pipeline
description: Shape-only generation leaves every model and part untextured grey. Hunyuan3D-2.1 ships hy3dpaint, which needs a compiled custom_rasterizer, the DifferentiableRenderer, and a RealESRGAN checkpoint -- all deliberately dropped from the current image because they broke the build. Needs a second image or an extended one.

title: Wire semantic segmentation into the pipeline and CLI
description: segment_semantic + RemoteSAMSegmenter work but are not reachable from 'pixiecad run'. Needs a --segmentation semantic flag, threading the executor through to the segmenter, stage caching of the SAM labels (they are expensive and deterministic), and a fallback to the geometric path when no GPU host is configured.

title: Semantic part segmentation via multi-view 2D segmentation
description: Hunyuan output is a single fused shell (99.96% of area in one connected component), so connected-component splitting finds nothing and the pipeline falls back to k-means clustering, which carves arbitrary spatial blobs instead of semantic parts. Fix: render the mesh from N angles with a face-ID buffer, segment each RGB render with SAM on the GPU host, back-project masks to faces via the ID buffer, and fuse labels across views by voting.
acceptance_criteria: F1 mesh splits into semantically distinct parts (four separate wheels) rather than positional blobs; deterministic and covered by tests

title: Bake normal maps in the generative path
description: The dashboard calls run_build with bake=False, so no normal map is produced for generative meshes. The pre-decimation Hunyuan mesh is a valid high-poly source, and bake_object_space_normals already exists. This would restore surface detail at texture cost rather than polygon cost.

title: Rear wheels still merge with sidepods and rear wing
description: Semantic segmentation separates the front wheels, front wing, floor, engine cover and halo, but the rear wheels stay fused with the sidepods and rear wing in one region holding ~44% of the surface. Likely causes: the rear wheels are occluded in most cardinal views, and SAM's masks there span the whole rear corner. Worth trying more camera positions around the rear, or prompted (text-conditioned) segmentation for 'wheel'.

title: Test whether edge/contrast preprocessing helps generation
description: User proposed edge-filtering input photos to help the model separate close parts. Prior expectation is that it hurts: Hunyuan conditions on natural RGB and an edge map is far out of distribution -- the same class of mistake as swapping DINOv3 for DINOv2, which produced a cube of noise. Worth measuring cheaply: compare baseline vs unsharp-mask vs contrast-normalised vs edge-only on the same object, rendering all four.
close_reason: Withdrawn at user request: the model conditions on natural RGB photographs, so edge maps are out of distribution. The real lever for merged parts is octree resolution, now exposed in the dashboard.

value: TRELLIS.2 requires an HF token: it loads facebook/dinov3-vitl16-pretrain-lvd1689m which is a GATED repo. The 401 only surfaces AFTER downloading 19GB and several minutes of loading, so always check the token before provisioning. Accept licence at huggingface.co/facebook/dinov3-vitl16-pretrain-lvd1689m, then export HF_TOKEN.

Hunyuan3D multi-view (2mv) is WORSE than single-view 2.1 on the F1 set: 2mv merged the front wheels into a slab and gave 18 components vs 5 for single-view, which kept four distinct wheels. Swapping left/right views changed nothing, so it is not a tag-convention issue -- 2mv is built on the older 2.0 line. Default is single-view 2.1; --multiview is opt-in.

L4 spot is persistently stocked out in all three asia-south1 zones (verified twice, 2026-08-02). asia-southeast1-b has capacity. L4 quota is 1 on-demand + 1 spot in every region checked, so sweep zones for spot rather than paying ~4x for on-demand.

S0 ingest is nowhere near needing cloud offload: the entire local pipeline (ingest, clean, decimate, UV unwrap, normal bake, parts export) peaks at 247 MB RSS in 1.9s on 8 1024px images. Only S2b dense stereo and S3 generative need a GPU host.

Spot is a bad fit for the TRELLIS leg specifically: ~15min cold start (9GB image pull + 19GB model download) and preemption DELETEs the boot disk, losing the whole cache. One run was preempted 8 min in. COLMAP dense is fine on spot because it is short and the stage cache absorbs a restart.

The TRELLIS image is built with TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=8.9 and no +PTX, so it ships Ada cubins only. A T4 (7.5), A100 (8.0) and H100 (9.0) all fail at kernel launch regardless of VRAM. L4 is the required GPU; availability checks must test compute capability, not just VRAM.

Hunyuan3D paint (texture) stack: bpy MUST be 4.2.x (oldest cp311 wheel; 5.x is cp312) and needs libxkbcommon0/libsm6/libice6/libxxf86vm1/libxfixes3/libxrandr2/libxinerama1/libxcursor1 even headless. basicsr needs functional_tensor->functional patched via find+sed (importing basicsr to locate it is what fails). Run the container with -w /opt/hunyuan (configs are relative to repo root) and pin realesrgan_ckpt_path absolutely. CRITICAL: end the script with os._exit(code) -- bpy teardown returns non-zero after a clean run, so a fully successful job reads as failed. 123s on an L4 for 2048x2048 PBR maps.

Part segmentation on a fused generative mesh: render 14 views keeping a face-id buffer, run SAM per view, vote on mesh EDGES (agree minus disagree across views), then Felzenszwalb-Huttenlocher with k/area to form regions. Two designs failed first: clustering masks (SAM splits a wheel into rim+tyre in one view -> 90+ fragments) and cut-then-merge-by-mean-agreement (snowballs, one region went 13.6%->97.9%). Adjacency MUST be UV-seam-aware (_positional_face_adjacency); mesh.face_adjacency left 390 regions with no neighbour. SAM vit_h on a T4 = 125s for 14 views at 768px.

TRELLIS load-time host RAM: OOM-killed at 15.2GB on g2-standard-4 (16GB); still climbing past 28GB on g2-standard-8 (32GB). Use g2-standard-16 (64GB). Adding swap makes it worse - paging a model load onto pd-balanced wedges the VM entirely.

TRELLIS worker image kngsly/trellis2-worker is a FastAPI SERVICE (CMD python server.py, EXPOSE 8000), not a CLI. Protocol: GET /ready, POST /generate multipart with repeated 'images' fields returning an NDJSON stream whose last frame carries success+glb_path, GET /download/<name>. Bind-mount /outputs to read the glb straight off the host instead of downloading it.
